title: Cowboys DE Charles Snowden suspended for first 3 games of NFL season following plea deal on DUI charge

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys DE Charles Snowden suspended for first 3 games of NFL season following plea deal on DUI charge
sources.description: Snowden reached a plea deal in January to reduce a 2024 DUI charge from when he was with the Raiders to reckless driving. Per police, Snowden's BAC was more than twice the legal limit.
